managedNotice.message: AI services in this browser follow the policy set in this extension.

extDescription.message: Warns about or blocks AI services and checks what you send to them for personal data and keys. Everything stays in this browser.

yourCompany.message: the AI policy set in this browser

blockedBody.message: $SERVICE$ is blocked by $COMPANY$, so it cannot be opened in this browser.

blockedHelp.message: This is set in the extension's settings. If an administrator manages them, ask your IT or security team.

warnHeading.message: Take care with this AI service

warnBody.message: $COMPANY$ shows a warning for $SERVICE$. Do not enter company, customer or personal information into it.

warnReasonLabel.message: Why do you need to use it? (required)

warnReasonPlaceholder.message: For example: reading the public documentation of an API

warnNotice.message: If you continue, your reason and the site name are noted in this browser's activity log, and the service is allowed for $MINUTES$ minutes. Nothing is sent anywhere.

proceedFailed.message: Could not continue. Please try again.

optionsManaged.message: These settings are managed by your organization and cannot be changed here.

promptBlockedBody.message: It contains information that $1 does not allow to be sent to AI services.

promptBlockedNote.message: Remove the information below and send again. The check ran in this browser; what you typed was not sent anywhere.

promptWarnBody.message: This message may contain information that $1 asks you not to send to AI services.

promptWarnNote.message: If you send it anyway, that is noted in this browser's activity log (not what you typed).

promptUnavailableBody.message: The message could not be checked, and $1 does not allow unchecked messages to AI services. Try again in a moment.

fileBlockedBody.message: $1 does not allow it to be sent to AI services.

fileBlockedNote.message: The check ran in this browser. The file name and the rule that matched are noted in the activity log, not the file.

fileWarnTitle.message: Check this file before you attach it

fileWarnBody.message: It may contain information that $1 asks you not to send to AI services.

fileWarnNote.message: If you attach it anyway, that is noted in this browser's activity log.

fileUnscannable.message: this kind of file cannot be checked

fileUnavailable.message: could not be checked right now

fileTooMany.message: Attach at most $1 files at a time so each can be checked.

promptMustMaskNote.message: Edit the message, or send it with the information above masked.

promptMaskFailedTitle.message: The message could not be masked

promptMaskFailedBody.message: This page did not accept the change, so nothing was sent. Remove the information yourself and send again.

noticeInspectionPrompts.message: On AI sites, the messages you send are checked in this browser against the data rules set here before they go. Nothing is sent to anyone else.

noticeInspectionFiles.message: On AI sites, the text of files you attach is checked in this browser against the data rules set here before they go. Nothing is sent to anyone else.

noticeInspectionBoth.message: On AI sites, the messages you send and the text of files you attach are checked in this browser against the data rules set here before they go. Nothing is sent to anyone else.

localNotice.message: All settings and the activity log stay in this browser. This extension does not connect to any server.

optOrganisationHint.message: Shown on the blocked and warning pages

optDefaultAction.message: Known AI services, unless set below

optDefaultActionHelp.message: Allow: opens normally and what you send is checked. Warn: asks for a reason first. Block: cannot be opened.

secServicesHelp.message: A service covers its domains and every sub-domain. Add your own for a service that is not listed.

secChecksHelp.message: Applies to every AI service that is not blocked. The check runs in this browser before anything is sent.

optCheckFiles.message: Check the files I attach (text, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

optUnscannable.message: Files that cannot be read here (images, PDF, archives)

optUnscannableHelp.message: The free edition does not read text inside images or PDF files.

secRulesHelp.message: Warn: shows what was found and offers to mask it or send anyway. Block: the message or file is not sent.

optRulePattern.message: Keywords separated by commas, or an expression

optTryHelp.message: Type or paste text to see what the rules in force would find. Nothing is saved.

secLogHelp.message: The last 500 events, kept in this browser only. It records the site and the rule, never the text or the file.

secBackupHelp.message: Save the settings as a file to move them to another browser or share them with a team. An administrator can push the same file through browser policy.

confirmReset.message: Reset every setting to its default? Your own services and rules are removed.

errService.message: Enter a name and at least one valid domain, such as example.com.

errRuleName.message: Enter a name for the rule.

errRulePattern.message: Enter the keywords or the expression.

errRuleTooLong.message: The pattern is too long (500 characters at most).

errRuleInvalid.message: That is not a valid regular expression.

errRuleSlow.message: That expression is too slow on some text and would freeze the check. Make it simpler.

errRuleEmpty.message: That expression matches empty text. It must match at least one character.

errImport.message: That file is not a settings file.

errAccess.message: The browser was not given access to that site, so the service was not added.

secServerHelp.message: An organization can run its own small management server and have every browser download the same settings from it. While connected, the settings come from the server and cannot be changed here. The extension only downloads settings: nothing about you or what you send goes to the server, and the activity log stays in this browser.

confirmDisconnect.message: Disconnect from the management server? This browser's own settings are used again.

serverStatusHeld.message: The settings downloaded earlier stay in force.

serverStatusPolicy.message: The server address was set by your administrator.

serverErr_address.message: That is not a usable server address.

serverErr_network.message: The server could not be reached.

serverErr_unauthorized.message: The server did not accept the enrollment key.

serverErr_notFound.message: No management server answered at that address.

serverErr_invalid.message: The server's answer could not be read.

optionsServerManaged.message: These settings come from your organization's management server and cannot be changed here.

serverNotice.message: The settings are downloaded from your organization's management server ($1). The activity log stays in this browser, and nothing about you or what you send goes to the server.
